Second homologue : ${CH}_{3}COOH$
$= {C}_{2}{H}_{4}{O}_{2}$

Hence, the answer is B.

questions.q:
$0 . 25g$ of an organic compound containing chlorine gave $0 . 40g$ of silver chloride in Carius estimation. The percentage of chlorine present in the compound is [in nearest integer]
(Given: Molar mass of $Ag$ is $108g{mol}^{- 1}$ and that of $Cl$ is $35 . 5g{mol}^{- 1}$)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Percentage of chlorine in the organic compound=$\dfrac{atomicmassofchlorineXmassofAgClformedX100}{molecularmassofAgClXweightoforganiccompound}$

Mass of organic compound $= 0 . 25g$

Mass of~$AgCl$~formed $= 0 . 40g$

Mass of~$Cl$~in organic compound~$= \dfrac{0 . 40 \times 35 . 5}{143 . 5 \times 0 . 25}$

Percentage of~$Cl$~in the compound~$= \dfrac{0 . 40 \times 35 . 5}{143 . 5 \times 0 . 25} \times 100$

$= 39 . 58 %$

Nearest integer=40.
